description: A single message thread inside a phone frame, with heart reactions and simulated replies.
overview: A single conversation in a phone frame, with a contact header, message bubbles, heart reactions and a composer. Double-clicking a bubble, or pressing Enter on it, toggles a heart. The frame appears from small tablets up while the smallest screens show the thread edge to edge, and on desktop a caption sits beside the phone. It works for showing off a chat feature on a marketing page or as the base of a one-to-one chat view.
usage: Replace `opening` with your initial messages, each with an id, sender, text and an optional liked flag. The `send` function fakes a typing indicator and a reply from `replies`, so wire it to your messaging backend instead. Update the contact name and initials, and point the `#contact` link at a real profile.
notes: Each bubble is a button whose label includes the message and how to toggle the heart, so reactions work from the keyboard.
